Alarm creates an immobile and invisible 10-meter diameter circle around the wizard, who also whispers a password while casting. If anyone without the proper password enters the area, the spell emits a warning in the wizard's voice that continues until someone speaks the password or it expires. This makes surprise attacks impossible. The wizard's warning may be as loud as he can generate with his own voice. Successlevel: Good: If the wizard chooses, Duration is increased up to one week and the circle may be expanded to 100 meters.

  • Outstanding: As Good, the alarm can be silent if the wizard chooses, and he knows if it's been triggered no matter how far away he is
"}
